ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity mottle patch located in the proximal-medial quadrant of the left lobe; dense array of light-intensity linear striations concentrated across the distal half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth occupies roughly 12% of the visible vertical span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude variations and distinct jagged valleys between the 70-90% distal marks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve across both lobes; the right lobe follows a convex sweep that tapers into a narrow, slightly recurved distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixels (white) located along the superior margin and distal tip area of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel dark-tone vertical marks (rake marks) on the distal right lobe; extensive network of fine, light-tone multi-directional scratches across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip; irregular erosion visible on the far-left lobe distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe displays a significantly more 'tattered' trailing edge profile and a higher density of linear scarring compared to the left lobe.
